scope: Read-only local recomputation of final matrix _03 raw evidence; no GPU execution, remote access, or runtime changes during this audit.

method.timing: For each layer and each rank, recompute median of the 10 raw CUDA-event milliseconds per planner invocation. Each raw sample is averaged over 5 CUDA Graph replays. Take maximum of the eight rank medians for that layer. Average those values across the same eight layers and multiply by 1000 for microseconds.
method.validation: Assert completion/exit codes, raw sample/rank completeness, finite positive timing, raw sample maxima, per-rank medians, final per-layer maxima, fixed fixture/config/environment/identities, complete per-rank output hash dictionaries, audit dictionaries, candidate diagnostics, and log pass records.
method.hashes: SHA256 of raw file bytes for source/evidence; output SHA256 entries were produced by the benchmark from complete array.tobytes(). The reference hash dictionaries are included below. Their dictionary fingerprints use sorted-key compact JSON UTF-8.
method.source: Old source checked against git show 407c223:path bytes from the actual local repository, with exact tracked moonep .py/.cu/.cuh keyset. New measured source checked against staging file bytes and source_manifest_03.json, including exact keysets. All three measurement harness files checked against staging.
method.test_case_count: 53 unique collected test cases = 24 config + 9 component + 5 compatibility + 15 public. Eight-rank repetitions of the latter two suites are execution observations, not additional independent test cases.

boundaries: Timing covers the complete planner and its live metadata/table collectives; excludes histogram construction, allocation/JIT, expert/token/gradient payload, GEMM and optimizer. It is not a complete training-step latency measurement.

Communication benefit is computed from exact replayed route plans against native MoonEP. This report does not measure token or expert payload transfer latency or prove positive training end-to-end benefit.
The reduced-SM implementations preserve the previous sampled planner result; they do not improve its communication benefit.
No trace-derived kernel durations are used for latency averages. Profiler startup and cross-rank waits can perturb trace durations.
This audit verifies the completed _03 matrix and logs. Deselected tests, other shapes, other hardware and unmeasured workloads are not claimed as validated.
SM budget trace analysis is a separate audit. Launched CTA limits are not measured active-SM occupancy or exclusive assignment to particular SM IDs.

Source file hashes establish correspondence of measured files to the frozen base/staging source; build dependency binaries and GPU machine state were not independently reconstructed in this local audit.
